simple_simultaneous_family.risk: max_j U_plus(K_mj, A_mj; delta_r/M) for every frozen m
simple_simultaneous_family.coverage: min_j L_minus(A_mj, n_j; delta_c/M) for every frozen m

holm_iut_family.member_pvalue: p_m = max_j BinomCDF(K_mj; A_mj, alpha), with p_m = 1 when A_mj = 0

strict_bounded_mixture.role: secondary branch, not the v18 headline comparison
strict_bounded_mixture.single_selector_risk_allocation: delta_r/(3S) for each of the three simultaneous endpoint families
strict_bounded_mixture.simple_family_risk_allocation: delta_r/(3SM) for each selector, stratum, and endpoint family
strict_bounded_mixture.risk_endpoints: simultaneous lower and upper acceptance endpoints plus accepted-error upper endpoints
strict_bounded_mixture.coverage_endpoints: a separately allocated acceptance lower endpoint family
